purpose: Promote the simpler six-scalar direction-only mediator law after the registered direction-by-cardinality model failed its necessity comparison, without reopening causal outcomes or changing prediction bars.
only_change: Select the preregistered direction-only control as the candidate model because cardinality-specific gains improved joint SSE by only 0.1018% versus the frozen >=10% requirement.
model: For each component in {m15,m17,interaction} and grammatical direction, one zero-intercept scalar multiplies the frozen reader q_hat; row-held-out folds are unchanged.

predictions.pred_a_immutable_single_reduction: The v1 SHA and evidence validate; the only model change removes cardinality from mediator gains; no causal/model execution occurs.

predictions.pred_c_joint_and_each_group_predictive: Joint mediation has cosine >=0.90, relative L2 <=0.40, signs >=0.90 and cosine >=0.85 in every direction x template group.
predictions.pred_d_cardinality_rejected: The immutable cardinality SSE reduction remains <10%, so exactly six rather than thirty full-data gains are exported.
predictions.pred_e_no_reopening_and_price: Zero GPU/model forwards, causal installations, gradients, updates, effect-threshold changes, row changes, or vector changes.

terminal_rule: screen if all predictions pass; invalid if a/e fails; otherwise null.
